speaker: sprocket
text: [excited] Welcome to the Training Grounds! A few quick lessons and you are ready to race. I will tell you exactly what to press.

speaker: sprocket
text: [excited] You start in a cannon. Press Space to fire it!

speaker: sprocket
text: Hold down to fire your Magic Engine for a burst of speed. Watch the heat bar!

speaker: sprocket
text: Press Q to use your Speed Boost. Your skills live on Q W E R and A S D F.

speaker: sprocket
text: [excited] A crate! Press Space to jump over it.

speaker: sprocket
text: [excited] Mind the gap! Press Space to jump it.

speaker: sprocket
text: See the green arrows? Roll through them and you switch to the back lane.

speaker: sprocket
text: A door back to the middle lane. Press up to go through it.

speaker: sprocket
text: [excited] A shortcut ledge! Jump onto it to skip the long way round.

speaker: sprocket
text: [laughs] That is it. Roll to the finish and let us go racing!
